title: Feed the Pet: A Gentle Game of Taps and Pet Orders
author: Jason Lamb
excerpt: A touch-friendly feeding game for children, with free play, picture challenges, spoken orders, and unlockable pets.

cover.alt: Feed the Pet game showing a friendly pet and colorful food choices

content_html:
Feed the Pet is a small, touch-friendly game for young children. Pick a puppy, kitten, bunny, or panda, then tap foods to fill the bowl. Free Feed lets children choose any five foods from the tray.

Pet Orders adds picture challenges that practice colors, counting, and patterns. The game gives a simple order, such as finding something red or serving two carrots. A wrong choice leaves progress intact, so children can try again. New orders are spoken aloud, and the Hear again control repeats them.

Sound cues play after food taps, with a Sound button to mute or unmute. Completed rounds stay in the current browser tab across reloads. Finishing all three orders in a set earns an achievement, and achievements unlock additional pets. The game works without an account or server storage.

Desktop and mobile play

The large food choices and direct taps make the game easy to use on phones and tablets as well as desktop browsers.
